# Retro Desktop

> A Windows 3.1 style desktop and window manager for Linux and for Termux on
> Android (Termux:X11), written in Nim with Retro Nim UI, by Sultan Al
> Isaiee (@foxoman).

One program, `retro-desktop`: with no argument the desktop (the window
manager, the desktop's background, minimized windows as icons, its menu);
with an argument one of its programs: `progman` (Program Manager),
`control` (Control Panel), `tasklist` (Task List), `terminal` (Terminal;
`-e command` runs a command), `browser` (Retro Browser: Firefox with a 3.1
userChrome.css on its own profile), `setup` (Setup: Termux programs to
install or remove, apt-get underneath), `write` (Write), `clipboard`
(Clipboard Viewer), `open FILE` (a file or link in its program), `mines`,
`solitaire`, `reversi`, `run`, `about`, `exit`, `welcome`, `saver`, `help
[topic]`, `tour`, `storage` (Android Files), `notify` (as notify-send),
`sound EVENT`, `clock`, `calc`, `calendar`, `cardfile`, `charmap`,
`pictures`, `pdf`, `media`, `recorder`, `camera`, `dialer` (Termux:API),
`news`, `diskspace`, `share` (x11vnc), `taskbar` (Taskbar Properties). The
desktop has a panel (Windows 95's taskbar: Start and its menu, the windows,
the tray, the clock; on any edge) and the Desktop folder's icons.

- Install in Termux: `pkg install x11-repo && pkg install termux-x11-nightly libx11`,
  then `apt install ./retro-desktop_<version>_aarch64.deb` and `retro-desktop`.
- Build: `nimble build -d:release` (needs retroui >= 0.26.0); the Termux
  package: `sh tools/build-deb.sh` (with Retro Nim UI's Files, Board, Photo,
  Notepad, Mail and Communicator; Mail's app IDs from RETRO_MAIL_* in the
  environment while it builds).
- Screen readers: the programs tell Orca what they show through retroui's
  AT-SPI; the session starts a session bus where AT-SPI is installed and
  none was started (session.nim, `startScreenReaders`); the desktop's icons
  (deskicons.nim), minimized windows' icons and the Terminal's screen give
  their own nodes (`accessNode`).
- The window manager runs on the desktop's own X connection (retroui's
  `x11EventHook`); frames are X windows with title bars drawn by retroui's
  canvas.
- Other programs get the look through XSETTINGS, X resources, fontconfig, a
  generated "Retro31" GTK 3 theme (3.1 scroll bars, no overlay scrolling)
  and the "Retro31" Xcursor theme in ~/.icons (retroui's
  `classicCursorArt`, written at 16-64 px).
- The desktop's log: `~/.local/share/retrodesktop/desktop.log`; a crash
  ends it at once (`_exit`) and the session's supervisor (`watchOver`, a
  fork) starts it again, which takes the windows (five in a minute at most);
  a new start ends a desktop that does not answer the ping and takes its
  windows.
- Settings: retroui's `loadSettings("retrodesktop")` (scheme, desktopColor,
  pattern, wallpaper, wallpaperMode, font, fontFile, textScale, size, touch,
  maximizeNew, linuxLook, wakeLock, startProgman, panel, panelEdge
  (bottom/top/left/right), panelRows, panelWidth, panelAutoHide, panelOnTop,
  startSmallIcons, panelClock, clock24, backKey, night,
  nightFrom, nightTo, nightScheme, language, feeds, vncPassword, layouts,
  layoutSwitch, repeatDelay, repeatRate, key.<action>, saverPassword (a
  salted SHA-256), updateChecked, hijri (on/off), hijriAdjust (-2..2)); Program
  Manager's items and windows in "retrodesktop-progman"; the desktop
  icons' places in "retrodesktop-icons".
- The panel: `panel.nim`, an override-redirect window on any edge; the
  manager keeps it over the windows (`wm.onTop`, unless Always on top is
  off), leaves its room free (`wm.workInset`, `workRect()`; `workChanged()`
  fits the windows again), gives it its events (`wm.otherEvents`) and
  redraws it when the windows change (`wm.refresh`). Its Start menu is
  `wm.showMenu(items, x, y, above, big)` with `MenuItem.sub` for the menus
  beside; Ctrl+Esc asks `wm.startMenu`. Recent documents: common.nim's
  `noteRecent` (from `open`), `recentDocuments`.
- Snapping: zones are fractions of the work area (`Zone`), `layouts()` the
  Windows 11 layouts; a window dragged to an edge or corner shows a preview
  and snaps on release, then Snap Assist offers the others for the rest;
  the layouts open on resting on the maximize button or with Win+Z; Win+
  arrows follow Windows 11 (`winArrow`). Alt+drag moves (left button) or
  sizes (right button).
- Shortcuts: `wm.setShortcuts` (keyboard.nim's `DefaultShortcuts`, Control
  Panel > Keyboard); the Windows key's are grabbed whole (alone: the Start
  menu); the desktop's actions through `wm.shortcut`, the windows' (halves,
  maximize, minimize, layouts, Win+D) in the manager.
- A program's failure: `crash.nim` (`watchCrashes(role)`, `retro-desktop
  crash ROLE`), kept in crashes.log.
- Arabic: `ar.nim`'s `desktopArabic` with retroui's `toolkitArabic`
  (`setUiLanguage`); the manager draws titles and menus through `tr`; the
  panel is mirrored along the bottom or the top (Start at the right, the
  tray at the left; its menus open leftwards); Help shows
  `helpar.nim`'s topics.
- Write's Word documents: `docx.nim` (`readDocx`, `docxOf`); the Hijri
  date: `hijri.nim` (`hijriText`, common.nim's `hijriLine` with the
  settings).
- Programs talk to the desktop with ClientMessages on the root window:
  `_RETRO_DESKTOP` (1 cascade, 2 tile, 3 arrange icons, 4 the look changed,
  5 exit, 6 ask to exit, 7 ping: the answer goes in the root's
  `_RETRO_DESKTOP_PONG`) and EWMH's `_NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW`,
  `_NET_CLOSE_WINDOW`; they follow the look through the root's
  `_RETRO_DESKTOP_LOOK` property. `retro-desktop --retro-command n` sends
  `_RETRO_DESKTOP` n from a script.
- Terminal: `vt.nim` (xterm/VT220 escape sequences, scrollback, the
  alternate screen) and `terminal.nim` (a pseudo-terminal, a reader thread
  that wakes the window with an X ClientMessage, drawing in the CGA colors).
- Menus over the windows (the desktop's, the icons', the control menu, the
  panel's Start menu) are `wm.showMenu(items, x, y)`: override-redirect
  windows with the pointer and the keyboard grabbed; letters, arrows (Right
  opens the menu beside, Left closes it), Enter, Esc; `menuItem(label,
  keys, enabled, action, icon, sub)` (a picture at `menuIconSize()` pixels,
  `menuBigIconSize()` in the Start menu; `sub` makes the items of the menu
  that opens beside it).
- The screen's size is the root window's, from its ConfigureNotify
  (`wm.screenSize`), never Xlib's DisplayWidth (the size the connection
  began with: Termux:X11 changes it after the start).
- Alt+Tab shows a box while Alt is held (the keyboard grabbed to it; Alt's
  release chooses); frames snap to edges while moved; the programs open
  (their command lines from /proc, their windows' places) are kept in
  "retrodesktop-session" and opened again at the next start.
- Sounds: synthesized WAVs in ~/.local/share/retrodesktop/sounds, played
  with paplay (or termux-media-player, aplay); settings "sounds",
  "sound.<event>". Wallpapers "@Name" are drawn by art.nim.
- Minimized programs can be paused (SIGSTOP; setting "pauseIconic"); VirGL
  (setting "gpu") starts virgl_test_server_android and sets
  GALLIUM_DRIVER=virpipe for the programs started after.
- The screen saver starts from the desktop when XScreenSaverQueryInfo
  (libXss) says the screen was idle for the delay.
- Sizes in the window manager are the screen's own pixels: `devScale()` =
  the kit's `dpf(1)` times its pixel zoom `pxScale`.
